seo.title: NFT Collection Launch Checklist
seo.description: Complete NFT collection launch checklist from smart contract to sold-out mint. Covers allowlists, metadata, minting infrastructure.

content.intro: The complete NFT launch checklist covering smart contracts, metadata, minting infrastructure, and community coordination. Avoid the mistakes that kill launches.

items.title: Choose the right token standard
items.description: ERC-721 for unique items, ERC-721A for gas-optimized batch mints, ERC-1155 for editions.

items.title: Implement allowlist functionality
items.description: Use Merkle proofs for gas-efficient allowlist verification. Test with full allowlist size.

items.title: Set up mint phases correctly
items.description: Configure allowlist phase, public phase, and any holder-exclusive mints.

items.title: Configure royalty settings (EIP-2981)
items.description: Set royalty percentage and recipient. Consider operator filter for enforcement.

items.title: Implement reveal mechanism
items.description: Plan metadata reveal: instant, delayed, or Dutch auction style.

items.title: Add withdraw function with correct access
items.description: Only owner/multisig should withdraw. Test withdrawal to intended address.

items.title: Set per-wallet mint limits
items.description: Prevent whales from monopolizing. Different limits per phase.

items.title: Get contract audited
items.description: At minimum, use automated tools. High-value launches need professional audits.

items.title: Generate complete collection art
items.description: All artwork ready, traits verified, rarity distribution checked.

items.title: Verify trait rarity distribution
items.description: Confirm rare traits are actually rare. Check for unintended combinations.

items.title: Create metadata JSON files
items.description: Generate all metadata following OpenSea standards. Verify JSON validity.

items.title: Upload art to decentralized storage
items.description: Use IPFS or Arweave. Pin content properly. Record all CIDs.

items.title: Set up metadata server for reveal
items.description: If delayed reveal, configure server to return placeholder then real metadata.

items.title: Test metadata on all major marketplaces
items.description: Verify display on OpenSea, Blur, Rarible before launch.

items.title: Prepare collection-level metadata
items.description: Banner, logo, description, links for marketplace collection pages.

items.title: Create placeholder/unrevealed art
items.description: Design compelling placeholder for pre-reveal period.

sections.heading: Minting Infrastructure
sections.description: Build strong minting website and infrastructure.

items.title: Build or configure mint site
items.description: Use battle-tested platforms or build custom. No last-minute site changes.

items.title: Test wallet connections thoroughly
items.description: Verify MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet all work correctly.

items.title: Implement proper error handling
items.description: Clear messages for: sold out, not allowlisted, wrong phase, insufficient funds.

items.title: Set up CDN and load balancing
items.description: Prepare for traffic spikes. DDoS protection essential.

items.title: Configure RPC endpoints with fallbacks
items.description: Use multiple RPC providers. Implement failover for high availability.

items.title: Test under load
items.description: Simulate hundreds of concurrent minters. Identify bottlenecks.

items.title: Prepare mobile experience
items.description: Test on mobile wallets and browsers. Many minters use phones.

items.title: Set up transaction monitoring
items.description: Real-time dashboard showing mints, revenue, gas spent.

items.title: Finalize allowlist addresses
items.description: Lock allowlist 24-48 hours before mint. No last-minute additions.

items.title: Generate and verify Merkle root
items.description: Create Merkle tree, verify several random addresses can prove inclusion.

items.title: Set Merkle root on contract
items.description: Call setMerkleRoot function. Verify it was set correctly.

items.title: Build proof generation API
items.description: API endpoint to return Merkle proof for any allowlisted address.

items.title: Test allowlist minting end-to-end
items.description: Full test with real addresses on testnet. Verify non-allowlisted can't mint.

items.title: Communicate allowlist status to community
items.description: Provide way for users to check if they're allowlisted.

items.title: Plan for unclaimed allowlist spots
items.description: Decide what happens to unminted allowlist allocation.

items.title: Set up bot protection
items.description: Implement CAPTCHA or other measures to prevent bot minting.

items.title: Announce mint date and time clearly
items.description: Multiple timezone formats. Pin in all channels. Count down.

items.title: Publish mint price and supply
items.description: Clear pricing for each phase. Total supply. Any free mints.

items.title: Create mint tutorial
items.description: Step-by-step guide with screenshots. Video walkthrough.

items.title: Brief moderators on launch day
items.description: Mods should know common issues, scam patterns, and escalation paths.

items.title: Prepare anti-scam warnings
items.description: Post official links prominently. Warn about fake sites and DMs.

items.title: Set up launch day support
items.description: Dedicated support channel. Fast response for mint issues.

items.title: Coordinate with influencers/collabs
items.description: Brief partners on timing. Provide assets and talking points.

items.title: Prepare post-mint communication
items.description: What to post when sold out, if not sold out, or if issues occur.

items.title: Verify contract state before mint
items.description: Check Merkle root, prices, limits, phase timing one final time.

items.title: Monitor gas prices
items.description: Be ready to advise on gas settings. Pause if network is congested.

items.title: Watch for minting issues in real-time
items.description: Monitor failed transactions. Identify patterns quickly.

items.title: Update community on progress
items.description: Post mint counts at milestones. Build excitement.

items.title: Handle support tickets rapidly
items.description: Quick response to stuck transactions, allowlist issues.

items.title: Monitor for exploit attempts
items.description: Watch for unusual mint patterns, large purchases, bot activity.

items.title: Prepare emergency pause if needed
items.description: Have pause transaction ready. Know the trigger conditions.

items.title: Document any issues for post-mortem
items.description: Note what went wrong for future improvement.

sections.heading: Post-Mint Actions
sections.description: What to do after the mint completes.

items.title: Announce sellout or end of mint
items.description: Thank community. Share final numbers.

items.title: Execute metadata reveal
items.description: Trigger reveal at announced time. Verify metadata updates on marketplaces.

items.title: Withdraw funds to treasury
items.description: Move ETH to secure multisig. Don't leave funds in mint contract.

items.title: Set up collection on marketplaces
items.description: Verify collection, set royalties, add description and links.

items.title: Monitor secondary sales
items.description: Track floor price, volume, holder distribution.

items.title: Provide rarity tools access
items.description: Submit to rarity.tools, integrate rarity in your site.

items.title: Announce roadmap next steps
items.description: Keep momentum with clear next milestones.

items.title: Conduct launch retrospective
items.description: Document what worked, what didn't, for future launches.

proTips: Test your Merkle tree with the exact production list: Generate proofs for random addresses and verify on-chain. A wrong Merkle root means no one can mint.
Have emergency contacts ready: RPC provider support, hosting provider, smart contract devs—all on standby during mint.
Never change the mint site URL close to launch: Scammers monitor DNS changes. Any URL change gives them opportunity to create fakes.
Price allowlist mints to cover gas mistakes: New minters often set gas wrong. Slightly lower AL price compensates for their learning curve.
Prepare three versions of your announcement: Sold out, partially sold, not sold—have all three ready so you respond instantly.
